agents_slug_idx.name: agents_slug_idx
agents_slug_idx.where: "agents"."slug" IS NOT NULL AND "agents"."deleted_at" IS NULL

apps_org_slug_uidx.name: apps_org_slug_uidx
apps_org_slug_uidx.where: "apps"."slug" IS NOT NULL AND "apps"."deleted_at" IS NULL

execution_credential_connections_owner_c.name: execution_credential_connections_owner_check
execution_credential_connections_owner_c.value: ("execution_credential_connections"."scope" = 'personal' and "execution_credential_connections"."user_id" is not null) or ("execution_credential_connections"."scope" = 'organization' and "execution_credential_connections"."user_id" is null)

files_user_conversation_filename_uidx.name: files_user_conversation_filename_uidx
files_user_conversation_filename_uidx.where: "files"."project_id" IS NULL AND "files"."conversation_id" IS NOT NULL

files_user_filename_orphan_uidx.name: files_user_filename_orphan_uidx
files_user_filename_orphan_uidx.where: "files"."project_id" IS NULL AND "files"."conversation_id" IS NULL AND "files"."app_id" IS NULL

files_storage_payload_chk.name: files_storage_payload_chk
files_storage_payload_chk.value:
(
        ("files"."storage_provider" =  'db' AND "files"."data" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."object_key" IS NULL)
        OR ("files"."storage_provider" <> 'db' AND "files"."object_key" IS NOT NULL AND "files"."data" IS NULL)
      )

kb_files_storage_payload_chk.name: kb_files_storage_payload_chk
kb_files_storage_payload_chk.value:
(
        ("kb_files"."storage_provider" =  'db' AND "kb_files"."data" IS NOT NULL AND "kb_files"."object_key" IS NULL)
        OR ("kb_files"."storage_provider" <> 'db' AND "kb_files"."object_key" IS NOT NULL AND "kb_files"."data" IS NULL)
      )

plugins_source_id_uidx.name: plugins_source_id_uidx
plugins_source_id_uidx.where: "plugins"."source_id" IS NOT NULL AND "plugins"."deleted_at" IS NULL

plugins_org_marketplace_entry_uidx.name: plugins_org_marketplace_entry_uidx
plugins_org_marketplace_entry_uidx.where: "plugins"."source_marketplace_repo" IS NOT NULL AND "plugins"."source_marketplace_path" IS NOT NULL AND "plugins"."source_marketplace_plugin_name" IS NOT NULL AND "plugins"."deleted_at" IS NULL

skill_sandbox_replay_events_one_payload_.name: skill_sandbox_replay_events_one_payload_chk
skill_sandbox_replay_events_one_payload_.value:
(
        ("skill_sandbox_replay_events"."command_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("skill_sandbox_replay_events"."file_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
        + ("skill_sandbox_replay_events"."skill_mount_id" IS NOT NULL)::int
      ) = 1

tools_archestra_catalog_name_uidx.name: tools_archestra_catalog_name_uidx
tools_archestra_catalog_name_uidx.where: "tools"."catalog_id" = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001' and "tools"."agent_id" is null and "tools"."delegate_to_agent_id" is null and "tools"."deleted_at" is null
